title: llm_guard step config
description: LLM-as-judge check where a text-generation model answers a screening prompt and the first token of its answer decides whether the request continues.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published text-generation model.

action.description: What happens on an unsafe verdict: reject halts the pipeline, warn flags and continues, and redact is unsupported and behaves as warn.

safe_token.description: Prefix the verdict must start with (case-insensitive, leading whitespace stripped) for the request to pass.

prompt.description: The screening prompt: chat messages or one raw template; template, template_file and template_id are mutually exclusive and take precedence over messages.

messages.description: Screening conversation sent through the chat template.

role.description: Message role; unknown values are treated as user.

content.description: Jinja template rendered into the message text.

template.description: Inline raw Jinja prompt sent as a bare string, bypassing the chat template.

template_file.description: Path to a raw template file, resolved under the templates directory unless absolute.

template_id.description: Id of a workspace templates entry, resolved to its content at load time.

sampling.description: Sampling override for the judge call; only max_tokens, temperature and top_p are forwarded.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; 0 is greedy and a negative value keeps the engine default.

presence_penalty.description: Accepted but not forwarded by this step.

frequency_penalty.description: Accepted but not forwarded by this step.

stop.description: Accepted but not forwarded by this step.

message.description: Jinja template rendered on reject and returned as the failure message.

context.description: Typed Jinja variables merged into the prompt and message rendering context and forwarded to the engine's chat template (for example reasoning_effort, enable_thinking); keys are free-form.

tags.description: The judge model's reasoning and tool-call markers, inline or as a bare string referencing a workspace tags entry by id.

oneOf.description: Id of a workspace tags entry.

input_field.description: Accepted but ignored; the prompt decides what is screened.

marker.description: One marker string or a list; the first entry is the primary marker and the rest are alternatives.

tags.description: Reasoning and tool-call channel markers of the model.

reasoning_repeatable.description: Whether the reasoning channel may reopen within one generation.
